allTitle: (RHBA-2023:0887) Updated Fuse on EAP container images
title: (RHBA-2023:0887) Updated Fuse on EAP container images
portal_summary:
An update for fuse-eap-openshift-container and fuse-eap-openshift-jdk11-rhel-8-container is now available for RHEL-7 based Middleware Containers and RHEL-8 based Middleware Containers.

Red Hat Product Security has rated this update as having a security impact of Critical. A Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) base score, which gives a detailed severity rating, is available for each vulnerability from the CVE link(s) in the References section.

portal_description:
Users of Fuse on EAP container images are advised to upgrade to these updated images, which contain backported patches to correct these security issues, fix these bugs and add these enhancements. Users of these images are also encouraged to rebuild all container images that depend on these images.

Security Fix(es):

* hazelcast: Hazelcast connection caching (CVE-2022-36437)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
